scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,api,conv -c cyan,magenta,yellow "npm run dev -w @holocad/web" "npm run dev -w @holocad/api" "npm run dev:converter"
scripts.dev:converter: cd services/converter && uv run uvicorn holocad_converter.app:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8001 --reload
scripts.test: npm test -w @holocad/web && npm test -w @holocad/api && npm run test:converter
scripts.lint:converter: cd services/converter && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.format: prettier --write . && cd services/converter && uv run ruff format . && uv run ruff check --fix .
